$description: Theme registry, in the order Settings lists the themes. Four themes ship: Dark (id dark, first and the default), Light (light), Classic (classic) and High Contrast (high-contrast). `id` names the token file and the golden images; the theme preference stores the enum name (highContrast for High Contrast), and themeModeFromId accepts either. `label` is what Settings shows and may be renamed freely. `role` drives Material Brightness. A preference stored under any other name than an `id` or an `enumName` opens the default.
